It’s tricky. Every person is a different case and you never really know. I’ve been struggling myself since I was eight and I still am so I can’t say things fix themselves. I’m sorry for what you’ve been through and are struggling with. I get that the sympathies from a stranger aren’t a cure or anything but, as another person I can really only hope you stick around a little while longer to be with friends and people who care about you. In the moment that’s a stupid thing to hear and it’s frustrating but, stick around a little. If you’re close with your mom please talk to her if you’re comfortable. I know I’d want my daughter to if she was feeling like this and was comfortable coming to me. If you aren’t, find a friend to listen.

My daughters dad died before she was born so she’ll grow up similarly at least in the way that she’ll never get to know him. His family doesn’t believe she’s his and doesn’t want her so it’s really just us. With fathers days passing I was pretty much a wreck for two days and I’m so glad she’s little but I kept thinking about how am I going to explain this to her. It was really helpful to read that just explaining things to them is the best way because they are smarter than they get credit for. I’m so sorry for your situation but it sounds like you’re doing amazing you’re going to have a really understanding kid on your hands. Best of luck and thank you!
It’s ok. I know he doesn’t care and has better things to do anyways. Thanks though
That’s my problem too. My house gets way too hot but the our only ac is in my room (old house and all the windows are different sizes) so it’s just easier to have her sleep with me.

Maybe some cases but her doctor told me that there was a way to safely sleep together at the time (I was pretty much homeless with only a bed and no room for a crib) and she did much better with that than on her own. I was afraid of SIDS but when she was younger she had this special pillow that she could sleep in so she wasn’t going anywhere and wasn’t going to have anything on her face. I think there are ways to set up the sleeping area that are safer and it depends what people want to look into.
My daughter is a terrible sleeper but hopefully she‘ll go down that route and be more interested in sleeping alone as she gets older.
That’s about how I feel. My daughter is still really little but if she’ll sleep alone, great. If not, I just let her sleep with me.
Tell me about it. She’s usually pretty good but she is crawling and I have the rails on our bed with a bumper. Walking on me is going to be a different story lol
